g.text: How did training go in each arm?

text.style: font-size: 6.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #333333

g.text: The line is the mean over the arm's teams and the band one standard deviation around it. An

text.style: font-size: 6.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #333333

g.text: unfilled point is a mean over fewer than the arm's teams. Training episodes sample their

g.text: actions, while the teachers' lines are their rewards in the greedy evaluation episodes.
